method: Direct visual inspection of all nine original PNG files using view_image; image metadata and SHA-256 measured without editing or recompressing the files.
overall_result: The captured recovery and tmux layouts fit their desktop and compact viewports. No blocking visual layout defect was found. The fixture has a documented CJK font-coverage limitation.
recovery_disclosure: Desktop and scrolled compact captures show what is restored and state that SSH still requires authentication; passwords, terminal output and running processes are not saved. Local-shell relaunch starts new shells and does not restore prior commands or working directories.

compact_accessibility_review.visual_affordances: At 320x320, the pane menu shows full labels, a selected check mark, and fully visible rows. Recovery actions stay visible as content scrolls.

source_corroboration.observed: The selector uses a Select tmux pane tooltip and CheckedPopupMenuItem entries; each pane provides a Semantics label and selected state.

compact_accessibility_review.qualification_boundary: PNG inspection verifies visual labels, selection indication and layout only. Screen-reader output, focus traversal, touch target measurements, contrast ratios and scaled-text behavior were not newly tested by this review.

limitations: In tmux-native-desktop.png the Chinese sample characters appear as two missing-glyph boxes with the fixture fonts, while cafe with accented e and the check mark render. Full Unicode font fallback is not qualified by these captures.
The visual tests use production widgets with in-memory recovery and pane connections; the captures do not establish end-to-end SSH or native tmux transport behavior.
The compact recovery content is scrollable. Content cut at its viewport edge becomes visible in the subsequent scrolled captures; the action area remains fixed.

observations: Three idle panes and the three workspace tabs are visible. The selected Build server tab and SSH pane use clear selection accents.
The SSH pane offers Reconnect SSH and the local panes offer Start local shell; no restored terminal output or running process is implied.
The bottom message says the workspace was recovered and SSH destinations can be connected when ready. Pane headers, action controls and start buttons remain inside their bounds.
The complete SSH authentication and excluded-data disclosure is readable at 320x320 after scrolling.
Forget saved workspace, Cancel and Save are visible and fit within the dialog.
No horizontal text overflow, clipped action label or content painted outside the dialog is visible.
The scrolled 320x320 view exposes both preference labels and switches, with Remember terminal workspace wrapping to two lines.
The local-shell explanation is readable; the longer SSH disclosure continues below the scroll viewport.
Cancel and Save stay visible, and the scrollbar indicates further content.
At 320x320 the dialog remains inset from all screen edges. The title and opening recovery description wrap within the dialog.

The next preference row is partially clipped at the scrolling viewport boundary; the choices capture shows that row fully after scrolling. This is scroll clipping, not content painted beyond the dialog.
Cancel and Save remain visible in the fixed action area.
The centered recovery dialog fits at 1180x700 with readable text, both switches, Forget saved workspace, Cancel and Save visible.
The text describes restored workspace metadata, explicit SSH authentication, new local shells, and exclusions for passwords, terminal output and running processes.
Labels and disclosure paragraphs wrap cleanly, with no visible overlap or overflow.
At 320x320 the active pane fills the terminal area beneath the two toolbar rows; tabs, new-window and overflow controls remain on-screen.
The pane-selector label is intentionally ellipsized while its drop-down arrow remains visible. The adjacent split, zoom, search, copy and paste controls fit in the row.
Terminal sample text is readable and remains inside the active-pane border. The disabled copy icon is visually distinct.
Two terminal panes fit side by side beneath the window tabs and toolbar. The active pane has a blue border and terminal ANSI colors remain distinct.
The pane selector, split controls, zoom, search, copy and paste icons fit within the toolbar.

The sample cafe with an accented e and the check mark are visible. The two Chinese sample characters render as missing-glyph boxes in this capture font set; this image does not establish CJK font coverage.
The open 320x320 pane menu stays entirely within the viewport.
Both full Pane %1 and Pane %2 labels are visible with generous row spacing; a check mark identifies Pane %1 as selected.
The menu provides the full labels hidden by the compact trigger ellipsis. It naturally overlays the terminal while open; no menu item is clipped.
The selected pane expands across the desktop workspace while the window tabs, pane selector and toolbar remain visible.
The zoom control changes to the restore icon, and the active-pane border stays within the viewport.
No visible clipping or overflow appears in the terminal sample or controls.
